programmingWorkshop.title: MiniScript+ Programming Workshop
programmingWorkshop.description: Children learned programming basics with MiniScript+, explored the platform, and tested their algorithms through playful activities.
programmingWorkshop.longDescription: Children learned the basics of programming through MiniScript+, discovered how to use the ScripticX platform, and had the chance to test their algorithms with a small LEGO robot. We also used CS Unplugged activities to make core computer science ideas easier to understand, and the students really enjoyed both the unplugged challenges and the hands-on robot experiments.

VerifyCertificate.title: Verify a ScripticX certificate
VerifyCertificate.description: Enter the number printed on a ScripticX certificate to check whether it is valid and view its public details.

official.title: Official record
official.description: Designed to confirm certificates issued by ScripticX.

public.title: Public lookup
public.description: No account is required to check a certificate code.

private.title: Limited details
private.description: Only public certificate details are shown after verification.

form.title: Enter certificate number
form.description: Certificate numbers are printed with leading zeroes, for example 0001.
form.label: Certificate number

loading.title: Checking certificate
loading.description: We are looking up this number in the official ScripticX certificate database.

idle.title: Ready to verify
idle.description: Type a certificate code above to see whether it matches an issued ScripticX certificate.

invalid.title: We could not verify this certificate
invalid.description: The number {code} does not match a valid public ScripticX certificate. Check the number and try again.

error.title: Verification is temporarily unavailable
error.description: We could not reach the certificate database right now. Please try again later.

valid.title: This certificate is valid
valid.description: This certificate matches an official ScripticX record.

DataUsageDisclosure.title: How we process your data
DataUsageDisclosure.description: We collect only the information needed to provide the learning platform, save your progress, keep accounts secure, and improve ScripticX.
DataUsageDisclosure.noAccess: We do not sell personal information or use it for third-party advertising.

data.title: What we collect and why
data.description: We use account details, learning activity, technical information, and messages you send us to operate the platform, save progress, secure accounts, and provide support.

google.title: Optional Google Sign-In
google.description: If you choose Google Sign-In, we receive only your account identifier, email, name, and profile picture. We do not access Gmail, Drive, Calendar, contacts, or your password.

control.title: Your control
control.description: You can revoke connected account access and request access to, correction of, or deletion of your ScripticX data.

Team.title: Small team. Plenty of ideas.
Team.description: We work across education, engineering, design and communication, bringing different perspectives to everything we build.

profile.teamTitle: Meet the rest of the team
profile.teamDescription: ScripticX is built by people working across education, engineering, communication, research and design.

eric.bio: I like turning complicated ideas into language that feels simple and useful. At ScripticX, I work on communication and shape programming problems that help learners know what to try next.

catalina.bio: I keep one eye on how ScripticX communicates and the other on how it grows. My work connects marketing with finance so good ideas have a clear, sustainable path forward.

sanke.bio: I enjoy taking an idea from an early sketch to something people can actually use. I work across development, product design, events and educational content—wherever the pieces need to come together.

maia.bio: I care about the small details that make an interface feel natural. I combine development, UI/UX and problem writing to make learning feel clear from the first click to the final solution.

andreea.bio: I’m curious about how people experience a product, not just how it looks. Through UI/UX research and events, I turn feedback and real conversations into a more welcoming ScripticX.

daria.bio: I love giving ideas a visual identity that feels clear and memorable. I work on graphic design and UI/UX, shaping the details that make ScripticX feel unmistakably ours.
